profile.name: Md. Rakib Ahasan
profile.title: Senior .NET Backend Engineer | Fintech & Enterprise
profile.tagline: I build and scale fintech and enterprise backends that stay fast and reliable under real-world load.
profile.summary: Senior .NET backend engineer with 5+ years building and scaling fintech and enterprise platforms. Strong in ASP.NET Core, C#, SQL Server, Dapper, Redis, REST APIs, microservices, and Azure DevOps CI/CD, with proven work across payment systems, performance tuning, and zero-downtime migration.

experience.context: Sports membership and club-management platform · .NET 9, SQL Server, Dapper
bullets: Cut a high-traffic grid API from ~110s to 9–13s through query-level tuning and caching.
Integrated Adyen ACH, BACS, SEPA Direct Debit, and PayTo with merchant-account and API-key resolution across four regions.
Delivered Member, Venue, Invoice, and Payment modules in a modular .NET architecture with xUnit coverage for critical workflows.

experience.role: Software Engineer — promoted from Software Developer
bullets: Led a zero-downtime SQL Server → MySQL migration of 500 GB+ with a sub-2-hour cutover and rollback planning.
Sustained 99.9% production uptime for 50M+ users through systematic incident and performance analysis.
Automated Excel/PDF reporting with ASP.NET Core and Jenkins CI/CD, cutting deployment time from 4 hours to 30 minutes.
Delivered operational tools with ASP.NET Core and Blazor to improve business-process visibility.
Optimized SQL queries and stored procedures, cutting report generation from 10 minutes to under 2.
Built secure REST APIs with JWT authentication handling 10K+ daily requests at under 200 ms average response time.
Delivered ASP.NET / C# backend work, SQL Server schema design, API development, and bug-fix contracts.

projects.title: bKash Integrated Sales Management System
projects.problem: A nationwide sales platform needed to absorb 3× peak transaction volume while manual reconciliation delayed compliance reporting.
projects.approach: Profiled high-traffic paths, applied targeted indexing and query-plan optimization, and replaced manual reconciliation with an automated compliance report.
projects.result: 3× peak volume on the same infrastructure and a 40-hour monthly reconciliation reduced to a 2-hour automated run.

projects.title: JustGo Membership & Payments Platform
projects.problem: An enterprise sports platform needed one backend for membership, booking, venue, invoicing, and multi-region payments.
projects.approach: Built modular REST APIs and integrated Adyen ACH, BACS, SEPA, and PayTo with cart/store-based merchant and API-key resolution.
projects.result: A single API powers web and mobile clients across four regions; one hot grid endpoint improved from ~110s to 9–13s.
